newsitem.title: CHINA: FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET SURGES ON DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET SURGES ON DEMAND.

text.p: Soaring demand for building materials fuelled healthy growth in first-half earnings at Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
Fangda on Tuesday posted net profits of 75.4 million yuan for the first half, a jump of 71 percent year-on-year under international accounting standards.
The company received several major orders worth 20 million yuan each for its core product, curtain wall glass, in the first six months of 1997, the official said.
"Demand for our product has increased sharply ... due in part to a pick-up in China's property market," he said.
Curtain wall glass is used for exterior building decoration.
Fangda offered and listed 30 million new B shares in June to boost production capacity of curtain wall glass.
The company expects to maintain the strong performance for the whole of 1997, the spokesman said. It has received total orders worth 400 million yuan so far.
Brokerage Shenyin & Wanguo Securities recently recommended Fangda's B shares as a "buy", saying the company was set to expand strongly in the next two years.
As of the end of June, the company had 240 million outstanding shares, made up of 100 million B shares, 28 million A shares and 112 million non-public shares.
Earnings per share were 0.315 yuan in the first half compared with 0.301 yuan the year before based on Chinese accounting standards.
Net assets per share were 3.02 yuan, up from 2.41 yuan in the first half of 1996.
The company will not issue an interim dividend.
